name: fablewright
description: Risk-gated multi-model orchestration. Claude Fable 5.1 writes the specification and accepts the result; pinned GPT-5.6 Luna, GPT-5.6 Terra, DeepSeek V4 Flash and GLM-4.6 lanes implement it; a fresh cross-family reader returns one verdict. Every route is declared before the first delegation and every model pin is proven, not assumed.
